_source: No Trial3 manifest entry for EXTEUR. COND=0 skips the entire *Increment COND loop (CASE/MT/OTHERWISE record-layout + procedure generation), leaving only the fixed batch/DB skeleton. DEVISE,1,1=1 (not 3) and DEVISE,1,3,1='NONE' (not 'KEEP') take the simpler branches of the nested *If/*Else blocks around DEVISE handling, avoiding the need for DEVISE,1,1,3. DEVOUTPUT=0 takes the C-PHA-EUR-derived currency branch instead of a literal override.
